user.title: Connect to Huawei Cloud
user.description: Log in at [cloud.huawei.com](https://cloud.huawei.com/) → open "Find Device" → press F12 → Network, trigger one locate, then copy the whole Cookie request header and paste it below.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: All devices are selected by default. Each device gets its own location sensor and GPS tracker.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Huawei Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The Huawei Cloud session has expired. Log in again at [cloud.huawei.com](https://cloud.huawei.com/), open "Find Device", then copy a fresh Cookie request header and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired Cookie. Log in to Huawei Cloud again and copy a fresh one.
error.no_devices: No devices found for this account.

abort.already_configured: This Huawei account is already configured.

init.title: Reverse geocoding
init.description: The Huawei Cloud API returns coordinates only. Pick a third-party service to resolve a readable address.

refresh.name: Refresh location
refresh.description: Ask Huawei Cloud to locate every device on the account.

set_cookie.name: Set cookie
set_cookie.description: Update the Huawei Cloud session cookie without the UI.
